purpose: Validate the true-search-cap runner (v3): deterministic termination, canonical output, cache/accounting integrity, and that the over-budget SEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED -> forced-submit conversation path is valid transport.
cache_handling: attempt-3 cache preserved aside at out/v8b1_cache_attempt3_preserved/ (moved, not deleted) so the cap canary ran fresh under v3 rather than serving a v2 cache hit.

live_cap_canary.fixture_note: first T2 infrastructure fixture (frozen, deterministic, excluded from primary sample); reused for infra validation, not scientific evaluation.
live_cap_canary.natural_over_budget_note: the model requested <=2 searches per response this run, so search_calls reached exactly 6 without a single-response burst; the SEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED excess branch was therefore not triggered by natural model output in this run. The cap held regardless (search_calls==6).

over_budget_path_probe.why: Because the natural run did not burst past six searches in one response, the live over-budget SEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED -> forced-submit CONVERSATION path was validated with a targeted synthetic transport probe (no evidence packet, no football content, no target outcome).
over_budget_path_probe.unit_tests_also_cover_this: tests/research/hypothesis_v8b1/test_runner_termination.py::test_true_execution_cap_excess_searches_in_one_turn and ::test_cap_across_turns_never_exceeds_budget prove the runner emits SEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED for excess calls, answers every toolUseId, caps search_calls at 6, and forces submit.
